summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend verification of Apollo Builders pre-launch iteration. Backend: 40/40 pytest tests pass (test_enquiries.py 8/8, test_api.py 6/6, test_route_parity.py 26/26). Health returns email_provider=configured. Live enquiry POST with delivered@resend.dev returns 201 with email_sent=true — Emergent Resend proxy delivering successfully to info@apollobuilders.com.au. Honeypot + <3s submissions silently rejected. Invalid email returns 422. SEO audit reports 0 P0 issues (all 21 canonical URLs 200, canonical/noindex/JSON-LD/legacy redirects correct, sitemap 200, robots 200). Frontend: broken-image audit across all 24 required routes — 23 clean, 1 issue found & FIXED (see below). Nav/footer text wordmark ('Apollo Builders') present on every route; no in header or footer. All 4 form flows verified end-to-end: consult-form → /thanks; bbb-form → /thanks; kitchen-form → /thank-you; renovation-quote-form (3 steps) → /thank-you. 4s form-load-delay bypasses spam gate as expected. PhotoFrame placeholder renders cream/branded box in image slots — layout stays intact, no huge white gaps.

bugs_found_and_fixed.issue: Article listing rendered raw — since seoContent.js hotlinks were stripped to empty strings, 4 broken images (naturalWidth=0) appeared on the /resources index page. PhotoFrame was already imported but not used in the list tiles.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Replaced with inside the aspect-[16/10] frame. Re-audit confirms /resources now reports document.images.length=0 (PhotoFrame renders a branded placeholder div, not an tag) — matches every other route.
bugs_found_and_fixed.priority: HIGH (would have shipped 4 broken images on the top-of-funnel Resources hub)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py _send_notification_email correctly uses async httpx, honours EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY, and returns False on any failure without crashing the enquiry flow — good separation.

The stale test_api.py had assertions from the pre-Resend stub era (email_sent=False, provider='pending'); brought in-line with live behaviour and made list-enquiries test worker-independent (was relying on pytest.created_id across xdist workers, which is not shared).

Resource.jsx was the only page still using raw in the image-hotlink era — every other page under /pages/ correctly guards with PhotoFrame or `image ? ... : null`. Recommend a lint rule / grep in CI to prevent regression: `grep -rn '

PhotoFrame produces a decorative div (no ), so `document.images.length` intentionally drops to 0 on all routes without real photography — this is the intended fallback and confirms zero broken-image risk when the client's self-hosted CDN comes online later.
Renovation quote 3-step form uses en-dash '–' in option labels ('3–6 months', '$40k–$70k') — automation-friendly, but future test scripts should not hard-code hyphens.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (24/24 routes zero broken images post-fix, 4/4 forms navigate to thanks/thank-you)

seed_data_creation: 5 TEST_ enquiries dispatched via delivered@resend.dev (Resend sandbox recipient — no real inbox impact). All persisted to MongoDB with email_sent=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live email delivery is now wired via EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY → https://integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send. When testing form flows, always set recipient to delivered@resend.dev so the client inbox stays quiet. Renovation-quote form uses en-dash (U+2013) in button labels — use `data-testid^="quote-"` or `.first`/`.nth()` locators, not hardcoded ASCII hyphens. PhotoFrame is a DIV, not , so `document.images.length` on graceful-fallback pages is 0 by design — do NOT flag as a bug.
